# Dilemma v1.0.0

The first stable release of Dilemma, with scheduled and on-demand quizzes, native Discord polls, points, EXP, levels, rankings, cosmetic achievements and feedback in six languages.

## Hybrid free-model routing

- Try the preferred free models first. On recoverable failure, discover compatible zero-price models from OpenRouter's account-filtered catalog before retrying previous candidates.
- Preserve account provider preferences, privacy settings and guardrails. Never use an unfiltered catalog or switch automatically to a paid model.
- Require text input/output, JSON mode, controllable reasoning and adequate context. Exclude expired models and malformed or nonzero pricing; keep zero-price guards on inference requests.
- Rotate through the eligible pool, selecting up to three additional candidates per generation call. Keep existing quiz validation, per-model and overall deadlines, retry limits and publication safety.
- Fetch the catalog only when needed, share concurrent requests and cache it in memory for six hours. Use a three-second catalog timeout and 30-second backoff after failure. No idle polling or additional database queries.

## Upgrade

- No database migration or command registration refresh is needed from v0.8.1-beta.
- `OPENROUTER_DYNAMIC_FALLBACK` defaults to `true`; set it to `false` to disable discovery.
- Historical alpha and beta releases retain their original names. This release is stable, not a GitHub prerelease.
- Free providers still have outages and shared account limits. Model metadata and successful tests do not guarantee uptime or factual accuracy. OpenRouter currently announces retirement of the free Dots preview on 2026-12-31; the remaining preferred and discovered models provide alternative candidates, not an availability guarantee.
